description: This file is a JavaScript module implementing a Sass compiler interface using Web Workers, including path detection logic, class definition for Sass, and method implementations for style, comments, and worker communication.

classes.name: Sass
classes.description: A class representing the Sass compiler interface, managing worker communication, style, comments, and import callbacks.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Terminates the worker and clears callbacks and importer.

methods.name: _handleWorkerMessage
methods.description: Handles messages received from the worker, invoking commands or callbacks.

methods.name: _dispatch
methods.description: Sends commands and data to the worker, registering callbacks.

methods.name: _importerInit
methods.description: Initializes the importer callback and communicates completion to the worker.

methods.name: importer
methods.description: Sets the importer callback and notifies the worker to activate it.
